hero.titleLine1: Fiber inside the building. Into every apartment.
hero.subtitle: Installation partner for network operators and housing associations: in-house cabling (NE4), apartment connections up to the fiber socket (NE5), splicing and measurement — planned, documented and OTDR-tested.

items: Installation partner for network operators & housing associations
In-house team: NE4/NE5 installation, splicing, project management

signalJourney.title: Six stations, one light pulse.
signalJourney.subtitle: From the building handover point to the fiber socket in the apartment — every step planned, measured and documented.

steps.title: The handover
steps.description: The operator's fiber reaches the building. We take over the route at the building handover point (HÜP/APL).

steps.title: The building distributor
steps.description: Installation of the fiber termination point (GF-AP) in the basement or technical room — cleanly labelled and expandable.

steps.title: The fusion
steps.description: Precision arc fusion joins two fiber ends with minimal loss — measured and logged immediately.

steps.title: The riser (NE4)
steps.description: Vertical cabling through the building up to the floor distributors — coordinated with property managers and tenants.

steps.title: Into the apartment (NE5)
steps.description: From the floor distributor into every unit — neatly laid in conduit, cable ducts or existing routes.

steps.title: The activation
steps.description: Fiber socket (GF-TA/OTO) installation, OTDR acceptance test and handover report — ready to connect.

services.title: Network levels 4 & 5 — from a single source.
services.subtitle: Four core services, one point of contact from the building handover point to the fiber socket.

items.title: NE4 · In-house cabling
items.description: Building distributors, risers and floor distributors for multi-family buildings — coordinated with property managers and housing associations.

items.title: NE5 · Apartment connection
items.description: Cabling from the floor distributor into every apartment and fiber socket (GF-TA/OTO) installation — clean, fast and tenant-friendly.

items.title: Splicing & measurement
items.description: Precision fusion splicing and OTDR acceptance testing — every fiber measured, every report documented.

items.title: 24/7 service & fault clearance
items.description: Field dispatch team for fault reports on active operator contracts — ready around the clock.

otdr.title: OTDR signal simulator
otdr.subtitle: This is how we test every route: move the marker along the 5 km route and watch backscatter, splice loss and connector attenuation update in real time.

fleet.title: Equipment for in-building fiber.
fleet.subtitle: Our own equipment instead of subcontracting it out — shorter lead times, reliable schedules.

items.title: Installation vans
items.description: Fully equipped service vans with a splicing station for work right on site.

items.title: Fusion splicers
items.description: Precision splicing for building distributors, floor distributors and fiber sockets.

items.title: VIAVI / EXFO OTDR meters
items.description: Professional measurement equipment for gapless acceptance reports.

items.title: In-house installation tools
items.description: Core drilling, cable pulling and duct tools for clean routes through stairwells and apartments.
